verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is distributed as a GitHub repository you clone and run locally, with an `app` directory, npm scripts and a section on extending its rendering engines, so the source is readable. Nothing in the pack states what license the code is under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent confirmation that the full source is published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.
Extending: adding styles, rendering engines, or another AI
The whole thing runs on your own computer, with your own Claude Code or Codex.
